## Checklist

- [ ] `swift test` passes locally, and `./scripts/build-app.sh` builds
- [ ] Behavior changes come with a test (written first, seen failing)
- [ ] No network calls, telemetry or analytics added
- [ ] No new dependencies (or the issue where we agreed on it is linked)
- [ ] Clipboard content is never logged, and privacy-filter behavior is unchanged (or tested if changed)
- [ ] User-visible change: README / CHANGELOG updated
